subject: structural engine and accepted-history ownership

selected.structural_engine: RWO Core containing the evolved DagEngine
selected.accepted_history_owner: Orchestrator Runtime through one Accepted-History Port

rejected: running historical RWO reducer and DagEngine in series
allowing agents or frontend clients to mutate graph state
letting storage adapters recompute structural transitions
rationale: one deterministic transition owner prevents semantic drift
one atomic history boundary prevents partial event/cursor/command acceptance
RWO remains reusable and independently testable while runtime owns durability
